title: Venue occupancy – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Review occupancy and resolve venue conflicts
hero.lead: Understand week and season views, assign pitch areas correctly and resolve overlaps.

body:
Choose view, period, event type and venues

Venue occupancy reads existing calendar events. Choose Week for operational coordination or Season for a longer period, filter All, Matches or Trainings, and select home venues. Week compares up to four venues; Season can select all home venues. Selections are remembered per view. Loading, error and no-selection states remain explicit.

Read weekly occupancy

Move by week or return to Current week. Each day shows free venues or bookings. Matches show teams and competition; trainings show title, team and pitch area; other events use their event type. Private bookings hide their title. Setup time starts before the event and is included in overlap checks. Areas may be whole, half or named segments A, B and C.

Review season occupancy

Select From and To. Summary cards show total bookings, matches, trainings and days requiring review. Entries are grouped by venue and date with time, booking, participants, area and status. Mobile cards contain the same information and warnings as the desktop table.

Understand overlap and capacity conflicts

An overlap displays both events, the shared time and its cause: a missing area, an unspecified half, a whole-pitch booking, the same segment, or exceeded capacity. Yellow means coordination or clarification is required; red means the stored assignments cannot coexist. Correct the underlying calendar event rather than creating or deleting a separate occupancy record.

Assign area and setup time in the calendar event

After selecting a venue while creating or editing a training, choose its named segments or half/whole pitch. Open setup time and adjust the minutes before the event. Wait for the availability check. It reports clear capacity, coordination needs or a conflict and may offer free times or alternative venues. Matches are checked as whole-pitch bookings. While editing, the event is excluded from comparison with itself.

Print and investigate missing bookings

Print overview creates a PDF for the selected view, period, type and venues and is disabled without a venue. If a booking is missing, check calendar date, time, event type, venue, active filter and training area. A venue is selectable only when assigned as a home venue. Private titles are deliberately hidden. To understand a conflict, compare setup start, event end and both areas.
